text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

Tap Dance City slammed her hand down on 
the low table in the lodge with all her 
might.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You're kidding! You've gotta be kidding 
me, Trainer!?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If we don't have enough travel funds... 
Ah, stow away! We stow away! It's a 
time-honored tactic, after all!
choice_data_list: It's not like you're a real pirate...

text_block_list.text:
From after the Takarazuka Kinen until 
today, the first day of summer camp, our 
discussions have been running in parallel 
lines without consensus...

—An expedition to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe. Executing it requires enormous 
funds. Even more so if you're truly aiming 
to win.

Of course, we can receive some financial 
aid from Tracen Academy. However...

Travel expenses for companions are a 
different matter. No expenses will be 
covered for anyone unrelated to the race.

Even so, if he paid out of his own pocket 
to bring them along, he wouldn't even be 
able to maintain their cheap base of 
operations. That was the reality.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Reality, reality, and more reality... It 
just won't stop clinging to me. But...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Going global"—that's the one thing I 
won't compromise on! Unless I win and make 
a name for myself worldwide—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I can't gather the sponsors needed to 
build my ultimate goal: the "Eternal 
Castle."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

"To secure a place she could truly call 
home forever, she needed to challenge 
herself on a whole new level."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is 
a promise we made to our sponsor who's 
letting us use this base.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Toss aside that debt of gratitude?! Never! 
Out of the question! However...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My friends... You're telling me... to 
leave them behind...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I swore that I'd definitely take them 
there! I made a promise! To those guys who 
worked themselves to death for this!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Moment of glory! Together at the glorious 
moment of heartfelt rejoicing! That's what 
it is!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're saying... we can't celebrate 
together...

Tap Dance City, who was always quick to 
make decisions, had been deliberating for 
a long time.

For the sake of our goal, should we give 
up a fleeting pleasure, or...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Sorry, trainer... Just a little more...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Give me a little more time. I need to 
think...
